title: CountdownElementProps
description: The props of a Countdown: an optional title, the instant it ends in UTC, the text it shows from then on, and a light or dark theme. It shows days, hours, minutes and seconds left by the visitor's clock, ticking each second, and at and after `endsAt` the `endedText`. All text is plain, on one line, without control characters. A tale may hold several Countdowns.

title.description: A short heading above the countdown; none when left out.

endsAt.description: The instant the countdown ends, as ISO 8601 in UTC with a `Z`, such as `2026-12-31T21:00:00Z`. The server also checks that it is a real date and time.

endedText.description: The text shown at and after `endsAt`; the SDK's "ended" string when left out.

theme.description: `light` draws dark text on a light card; `dark` light text on a dark card. Light when left out.
